indicator_name: Number of registered and active legal entities by region, at the start of the month
description: Количество зарегистрированных и действующих юридических лиц по регионам, на начало месяца
methodology: Taldau 701159 (registered) and 701160 (active), period 8 («месяц с накоплением»): the value of month m is the stock on the 1st of month m+1 (y092026 = на 1 октября 2026 = the monthly bulletin's figure, 559 558 registered, 451 479 active); dated here at month m's first day, like the other monthly dims. 2011-01 onward. New registrations in a month are only in the bulletin (name=19202, sheet 1.8.).
